program_name: Bachelor of Information Technology in Graphics and Multimedia (Hons)

malaysian.diploma_pathway: Diploma in relevant field with CGPA 2.0

requirements.general_text: Foundation in Information Technology SPM / O-Level: Pass with 5 credits Math: C 4 additional subjects: C UEC: Pass with Grade B in 4 subjects Math: B 3 additional subjects: B Foundation in Computer Science SPM / O-Level: Pass with 5 credits Math: C 2 Science subjects: C 2 additional subjects: C UEC: Pass with Grade B in 4 subjects Advanced Math: B 3 additional subjects: B  All Engineering Programmes STPM: Pass with Grade C (CGPA 2.00) Math: C Physics: C A-Level: Pass with Grade D in 2 subjects Math: D Physics: D Matriculation / Foundation: Pass with CGPA 2.00 Diploma: Pass Diploma in a related field (CGPA 2.00) UEC: Pass with Grade B in 5 subjects Math: B Physics: B IB: Total 24 points in 6 subjects, including Mathematics & Physics Other Qualifications: Pass in SAM / SACE / AUSMAT / WACE / Ontario SSD (55% in Math + any Physical Science) Pass American Degree Transfer Programme (ADTP) (CGPA 2.00 in 2 years)  Information System (Business Analytics) & Information Technology (Graphics & Multimedia) STPM / STAM: Pass with Grade C / JAYYID in any 2 subjects Math (SPM): C Matriculation / Foundation: Pass with CGPA 2.00 Math (SPM): C Diploma (Computing Field): Pass with CGPA 2.50 Diploma (Non-Computing Field): Pass with CGPA 2.75 A-Level: Pass with Grade D in any 2 subjects Math (SPM): E UEC: Pass with Grade B in 5 subjects Math: B English: B 1 subject Science / ICT: B IB: Pass with 24 points Math: included Math (SPM): E Other Qualifications: Pass SAM / SACE / AUSMAT / WACE / ADTP (CGPA 2.00 in 2 years) Math: C Math (SPM): E   ENGLISH REQUIREMENTS For Malaysian Students: Malaysian students may enrol without MUET. However, students are required to complete MUET during duration of study (before graduation). IELTS (5.0 and above) or TOEFL (500 and above) or TOEFL Internet Based Test (42 and above) is also accepted. MUET – Malaysia University English Test Achieve Band 1 and above For International Students: International students are required to have one of the English proficiency score stated below to enrol in UNITEN. Bachelor students who do not fulfill this English requirement are required to sit for the Intensive English Programme (IEP) and pass the requirement below before starting their Bachelor programme. MUET – Malaysia University English Test Achieve Band 3.5 and above   IELTS – International English Language Testing System Achieve 5.0 and above   TOEFL - Test of English as a Foreign Language Achieve 500 (TOEFL) or 42 (TOEFL Internet Based Test) and above
